title: Plan Status and the Posting of a Later-Month Family Relief
content:
For a TRICARE Reserve Select plan under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans: How much of the later-month family relief is posted now follows the plan's state: where the plan has ended, the whole relief is posted now; where the plan is in force, it is posted now up to what that adjustment bill still owes; otherwise nothing is posted now.

A plan has ended when its status is terminated by request, terminated for nonpayment or terminated for ineligibility; it is in force when its status is active; "otherwise" is any other status, such as applied or rejected. What the adjustment bill still owes is the amount billed as adjustment less the payments and the credits already standing against that bill, never below zero.

| Plan status | Relief figured (hypothetical) | Still owed on the adjustment bill | Posted now |
|---|---|---|---|
| terminated for nonpayment | 69.87 | 240.65 | 69.87 |
| active | 69.87 | 40.00 | 40.00 |
| rejected | 69.87 | 240.65 | nothing |
